integrity: Every nontrivial labeled simple game through six players is generated from its unique minimal-winning antichain. Power comparisons use exact integer swing counts and exact Shapley pivotal-order weights; properness is cross-checked by complements and by intersections of minimal winning coalitions.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only through six players and compares weak ordinal rankings, not numerical distances between power vectors. The six-or-more existence of ordinal inequivalence is prior. The 1987 primary article was not available in full text during the originality check, so an unindexed historical exact table remains a residual risk.
title: Complete six-player ordinal-divergence layer for Shapley–Shubik and Banzhaf power
